items.quote: The figure opposite:
items.caption: Right-angled triangle ABC with right angle at B (marked), A at top, B bottom left, C bottom right. Side AB labelled 'opposite', side BC labelled 'adjacent', side AC labelled 'hypotenuse'.

items.quote: The triangle ABC represents the right angled triangle at B
items.claim: Triangle ABC is right-angled at B, where A and C are two complementary acute angles; the side opposite angle C is called the opposite leg, the side adjacent to angle C is called the adjacent, and the side opposite the right angle is called the hypotenuse.

items.quote: ABC is a right angled triangle at C, A B = 13 cm, B C = 12 cm
items.stem: ABC is a right angled triangle at C, AB = 13 cm, BC = 12 cm. A: Find the length AC. B: Find each of the following: sin A, cos A, tan A, sin B, cos B, tan B. C: Prove that: sin A cos B + cos A sin B = 1. D: Find: 1 + tan² A.

parts.label: A
solution: Since ABC is a right angled triangle at C, therefore $(AC)^2=(AB)^2-(BC)^2$

parts.label: B
parts.stem: Find each of the following: sin A, cos A, tan A, sin B, cos B, tan B

parts.label: C
parts.stem: Prove that: sin A cos B + cos A sin B = 1
solution: The right side = $\sin A\cos B+\cos A\sin B$

items.notes: Triangle figure k3 belongs to this example.

learning_objectives.label: Convert degrees, minutes, seconds
learning_objectives.description: Convert angles between degrees, minutes and seconds and decimal degrees, by hand or with the calculator.

learning_objectives.label: Compare sides and ratios
learning_objectives.description: Compare sides of a right angled triangle and ratios of sides to 1 using the symbols >, < or =.

learning_objectives.label: Calculate sin, cos, tan
learning_objectives.description: Calculate sin, cos and tan of an acute angle in a right angled triangle as ratios of the opposite, adjacent and hypotenuse sides, finding a missing side where needed.

learning_objectives.label: Prove ratio relationships
learning_objectives.description: Prove relationships between trigonometrical ratios of acute angles in a right angled triangle.
